show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/HfRG8W
show.description: Jassi is a sweet, innocent, yet highly intelligent girl who longs for genuine friendships. However, she's constantly ignored and humiliated by those around her simply because she doesn't fit society's conventional standards of beauty. With braces on her teeth, a unique sense of style, and an unconventional haircut, Jassi is often judged by her appearance rather than her character.
